messages:
maria: quick check — I'm about to merge #724 that moves tenant-a namespace into a dedicated TF module and wires IRSA. sanity check please? I updated the helm values and added an aws_iam_role in terraform. wondering if the annotation + secrets path look right. :eyes:

maria: helm values snippet i pushed to the pr:```yaml
serviceAccount:
  create: false
  name: tenant-a-sa
  annotations:
    iam.amazonaws.com/role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-tenant-a-role
secrets:
  s3_path: s3://redwood-secrets/prod/tenants/tenant-a
  mount: /etc/tenant-secrets
```

aj: couple things — the annotation key should be `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn`, not `iam.amazonaws.com/role`. IRSA expects the eks key. Also we generally don't put an IAM role arn directly in helm values for create=false flows; we rely on the k8s SA annotation pointing to role we create in TF. so TF should own the role and we annotate the SA with the role ARN.

aj: TF snippet i recommend (high-level):```hcl
resource "aws_iam_role" "tenant_a_irsa" {
  name = "redwood-tenant-a-role"
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.eks_irsa.json
}
resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "ssm_attach" {
  role = aws_iam_role.tenant_a_irsa.name
  policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMReadOnlyAccess"
}
```

kevin: +1 on eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn. also, for secrets path — we try not to bake s3 paths into helm values unless it's just a config pointer. how is the secrets loader implemented? are we using the sidecar that fetches S3 into a volume? if yes, mount path looks ok but ensure you added RBAC for the secret-syncer SA.

maria: secrets loader is the s3-syncer sidecar (helm chart redwood/s3-sync). it uses IAM on the pod (via IRSA) to call GetObject. so the SA needs the role with policy granting s3:GetObject on that prefix. i added the policy in TF but wasn't sure if the resource ARNs are right.

sophia: please ensure the TF policy uses wildcard for tenant prefix instead of exact object name. example: `arn:aws:s3:::redwood-secrets/prod/tenants/tenant-a/*` so new files are covered. also double-check encryption KMS key arn in the policy if objects are encrypted.

maria: ok i'll update that. one more question: do we need projected service account token volumeMounts for the sidecar or can it use the default token? our k8s is on 1.25 and we rotated to projected tokens earlier.

aj: the syncer relies on IRSA so it needs the projected serviceAccount token feature to be enabled cluster-side (it is for us). you don't need to manually mount a token if the container uses the standard in-cluster flow — but if you run with automountServiceAccountToken: false then you must add a projected token mount. verify the deployment template.

kevin: quick `kubectl` check you can run pre-merge:`kubectl get sa tenant-a-sa -n tenant-a -o yaml` if it shows `annotations: eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: ...` then helm/TF wiring is correct. also `kubectl describe pods -n tenant-a` after deploy to see if sidecar has auth errors.

maria: ran that locally against staging cluster (not prod):```bash
$ kubectl get sa tenant-a-sa -n tenant-a -o yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: tenant-a-sa
  namespace: tenant-a
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-tenant-a-role
```

maria: infra-bot pipe:ci reported helm deploy succeeded for staging. i'm going to change the annotation key in the values and update TF policy ARN wildcard, push an amend. any objections to me merging after tests pass?

aj: no objections, but add a short note in the PR description about the eks key change and why TF should own the role. also add a one-line test plan: how to validate in prod (kubectl sa check + check s3 object access via pod logs).

sophia: +1 to aj. also run `terraform plan` with the exact aws account/env workspace so we don't accidentally re-create roles in other accounts.

kevin: once merged, i'll do a quick smoke in prod-canary with the tenant-a namespace on dedicated nodes. i'll watch for 403s from the syncer. ping me when it's merged. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: [deploy-bot] Helm release redwood-tenant-a (staging) succeeded — 1 revision. CI: all checks passed.

maria: thanks everyone — i'll push the changes in ~15m and tag you.
